summary.text: Brenda Stanley is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 42 who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Christopher Jones as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Stanley assumed office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Jack Fry, and defeated Malana Bracht in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Senate Veterans and Military Affairs Committee and a member of the Senate Transportation, Finance, Health and Human Services, and Senate Rules committees and the Committee on Pandemic Relief Funding.
